sections.heading: A website for your small business, with the store and bookings built in.
body: Get your business online this week: pages, a contact form, appointment booking and a store on your own domain, with no developer. Describe your business and Aglyn AI drafts the site; edit it on the canvas; publish. Free to start, one price when you grow.

sections.heading: You shouldn’t need a developer, an agency, and three subscriptions just to get online. Aglyn gives you a professional site, a store, and bookings for one simple price.

sections.heading: Questions about a small business website builder.
body: Cost, bookings, selling, SEO and what Aglyn AI does for you, in plain terms.

items.title: How much does a small business website cost on Aglyn?
items.body: Nothing to build and publish on the free plan. Your own domain, bookings and the store come with the Starter plan; the pricing page has every figure.

items.title: Can customers book appointments?
items.body: Yes. Appointment booking with availability windows and reminder emails is built in from Starter.

items.title: Can I sell online and in person?
items.body: Yes. Online checkout and digital goods from Starter; in-person POS with inventory kept in sync from Pro.

items.title: Do I need a developer?
items.body: No. You edit on a visual canvas, and Aglyn AI drafts the first version from a description of your business.

items.title: Will my website show up on Google?
items.body: It gives you the parts that rank: titles and descriptions for every page, sitemaps, Search Console and Bing verification and an SEO check that scores each page.

items.title: Do I own my website, and can I move it later?
items.body: Yes. Your pages, media and customers live in your account, and Aglyn is open source and self-hostable, so nothing locks you in.

items.title: Can Aglyn AI build it for me?
items.body: Yes. Describe the business and who it is for, confirm the plan, and the pages arrive as drafts for you to edit and publish.

items.title: What is Aglyn?
items.body: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.

sections.heading: Get your business online.
body: Free to start — build your site, then add a store or bookings when you’re ready.
